accounts_card_settings_check.name: accounts_card_settings_check
accounts_card_settings_check.value:
"accounts"."type" = 'credit_card' or ("accounts"."credit_limit" is null and "accounts"."statement_day" is null
        and "accounts"."due_day" is null and "accounts"."min_payment_rate" is null)

categories_name_check.name: categories_name_check
categories_name_check.value: coalesce(char_length("categories"."name") between 1 and 40, "categories"."system_key" is not null)

recurring_rules_transfer_check.name: recurring_rules_transfer_check
recurring_rules_transfer_check.value:
case when "recurring_rules"."kind" = 'transfer'
        then "recurring_rules"."to_account_id" is not null and "recurring_rules"."to_account_id" <> "recurring_rules"."account_id"
          and "recurring_rules"."to_amount" is not null and "recurring_rules"."to_amount" > 0 and "recurring_rules"."category_id" is null
        else "recurring_rules"."to_account_id" is null and "recurring_rules"."to_amount" is null end

transactions_transfer_check.name: transactions_transfer_check
transactions_transfer_check.value:
case when "transactions"."kind" = 'transfer'
        then "transactions"."to_account_id" is not null and "transactions"."to_account_id" <> "transactions"."account_id"
          and "transactions"."to_amount" is not null and "transactions"."to_amount" > 0 and "transactions"."category_id" is null
        else "transactions"."to_account_id" is null and "transactions"."to_amount" is null end
